lines.zh: 我不落地，衣角在空中飘
lines.en: I do not land, my hem drifts in the air

lines.zh: 蓝皮肤在光下泛着冷色
lines.en: My blue skin takes on a cold sheen in the light

lines.zh: 我走在半空，步子是量好的
lines.en: I walk in midair with measured steps
Nobody follows behind me, that is fine

lines.zh: 气在脚下铺开，像踩着一层水
lines.en: Ki spreads underfoot like a sheet of water
I walk slowly because I need not hurry
My hands are behind my back, steady
I turn my head and my hair sways once
I have calculated this route three times
Wind comes from the side and I do not flinch
I raise a hand against the light

lines.zh: 这种地方，走起来没意思
lines.en: A place like this is dull to walk in
I hang there, watching the distance
My fingers rest on my cuff
My ki is held tight, showing nothing
This height gives a good view of the whole
I stay still because there is no need to move
Cold wind passes over my face
I reckon the distance, quite close

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，可站得住
lines.en: There is nothing underfoot, yet I hold
Four people in that grove

lines.zh: 我的残影拳，只留一个影。
lines.en: My afterimage fist leaves only a shadow.
I smooth the pattern at my cuff

lines.zh: 这个星球的语言，我学了几句
lines.en: I have learned a few words of this planet's tongue

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从下面看
lines.en: I dislike being looked at from below
I wait for the other side to lose patience
Looking up, can you see me

lines.zh: 我俯视你，这个角度最好
lines.en: I look down at you, the best angle
Your ki is muddled
I have calculated your reaction time

lines.zh: 你手里那件东西，太短了
lines.en: That thing in your hand is too short
I tilt my head and appraise you

lines.zh: 你站的位置不好，退路被堵了
lines.en: Your stance is poor, your retreat is blocked

lines.zh: 你这身衣服，不像是本地人
lines.en: Your clothes do not look local
I never look at a face
Do not tense up, I have not decided to move
Think before you open your mouth
Your breathing is uneven
I raise a hand and point at your feet
The angle of your wrist is wrong
You are not stupid, only slow
At this range I could strike first
I am waiting for you to say something
Hovering high, I wait for you to move first.
It grazed me, no matter
I drop back half a block and steady
Your technique has some form to it

lines.zh: 我低头看了看，又抬起头
lines.en: I look down at it and lift my head
Blood hardly shows on blue skin
I do not cry out, it would be useless
I miscalculated that one
I shift to a different angle
One nail has broken
My smile thinned further
You try to coax me with that
I glance at it and do not reach
I do not eat this, try another
You have held it a long while, your arm must ache

lines.zh: 我伸手接了，不代表什么
lines.en: I take it, but it means nothing

lines.zh: 赛亚人的胃口，你满足不了
lines.en: You cannot satisfy a Saiyan appetite
Leave it there, I will decide
You should not have wasted that
This will not buy information

lines.zh: 你的好意我记下了，东西不要
lines.en: I will remember the gesture, not the gift

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我在上面
lines.en: When you charged, I was above
I dropped half a block and settled
Do not touch my sleeve
You were three inches off

lines.zh: 我侧身，手背贴着你的肩
lines.en: I turn and my hand brushes your shoulder
Do not crowd, I dislike being close

lines.zh: 你退的时候踩到了石头
lines.en: You stepped on a stone as you backed off
I have noted that contact

lines.zh: 我没用气挡，你已经输了
lines.en: I did not even use ki to block, you already lost
Once more and I act
The Frost Demon line does not do such things
I choose people by usefulness first
Your worth is not enough

lines.zh: 我低下头，看着你，又抬起来
lines.en: I lower my gaze to you, then lift it

lines.zh: 这种事我从不放在心上
lines.en: I never keep such things in mind
Keep your hand where it is
My kind are few now

lines.zh: 你说这话，是不知道我是什么
lines.en: Saying that means you do not know what I am
I prefer being alone
That is the end of this talk
I raise a hand and it floats up
No bending needed, convenient
I turn it between my fingers
The material is inferior
I glance at it and toss it aside
Some use in it, I will keep it

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我懒得捡
lines.en: Things on the ground, I cannot be bothered
I weigh it, very light
The craft on this planet is far behind
I tuck it away, later perhaps

lines.zh: 我看见你了，一直都在看
lines.en: I see you, I have been watching all along

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作，你没注意到
lines.en: You did not notice my hand rise
The ki is already gathered
You go right, that is my side
There is no cover in this area
You have three seconds left
I have calculated the landing point
You have run a long while and must be tired
I have your breathing patterned
Do not count on rescue

lines.zh: 我的气弹很小，但那不重要
lines.en: My blasts are small, and that does not matter

lines.zh: 这一场，从一开始就定了
lines.en: This was settled from the start
I moved, you simply did not see it
Your companions I will not touch
Stop, save your strength
My afterimage still hangs where I stood
You swung at nothing, naturally
I am behind you, and was not before
The blasts come from the side
The more you panic, the less I exert
Within three steps you cannot dodge

lines.zh: 我停下来，只是让你靠近一点
lines.en: I stop, only to let you come closer
I keep your position noted

lines.zh: 你换了三次方向，我都数着
lines.en: You changed direction three times, I counted

lines.zh: 这片地形的死角，我清楚
lines.en: I know the blind spots of this terrain
I lift one finger a fraction
There is a gap in your armor, left ribs
Do not run uphill, it is more exposed

lines.zh: 你听不见我的脚步，因为我没有
lines.en: You cannot hear my steps, I make none

lines.zh: 我把气收细了，只留一线
lines.en: I draw my ki thin, a single thread

lines.zh: 这一轮打完，你就该明白了
lines.en: When this round ends, you will understand

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，圈子越收越小
lines.en: I circle and the circle keeps tightening
You still have one breath, keep it
I strike at a calculated angle
My hand chops at your collar

lines.zh: 这一脚很干脆，落在你膝弯
lines.en: This kick is clean, into the back of your knee
You were a little late
Ki balls up at my fingertip
You blocked it, your hand must be numb
The blow is not heavy, only precise
You retreat, and I do not follow
Your weight shifted forward

lines.zh: 我推了你一把，你就倒了
lines.en: I gave a push and you fell
That one is enough to silence you
Your weapon left your hand
I strike along your flank
One move still unused
You lost on speed
I descend above the clearing
I take a look first, then come down
A layer of ki spreads through the air

lines.zh: 蓝影闪过，我就站在那里
lines.en: A blue flash, and I am standing there
The wind paused half a beat, then me

lines.zh: 这片地方，需要一个明白人
lines.en: This place needs someone who understands it
I raise a hand and the ki disperses
My boots hover three inches up
Nobody called me, and I came anyway

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼对面的人数
lines.en: I count the people across from me
The hair settles first, then the rest of me

lines.zh: 我不喜欢开场，直接来吧
lines.en: I dislike openings, let us begin

lines.zh: 这一带的气忽然变冷了
lines.en: The ki in this area suddenly turned cold

lines.zh: 我站在树上，没有踩弯它
lines.en: I stand on a branch without bending it
My shadow appears first, I follow
There is a chill in the air

lines.zh: 我把袖子理好，慢慢抬头
lines.en: I set my cuffs and raise my head slowly
Now that I am here, do not think of leaving
Fire caught my sleeve and the edge curled
Coming down from height, my ki could not catch me

lines.zh: 水不太配合我，气也压不住
lines.en: Water does not agree with me, ki cannot hold it back
The blast left my hair disheveled
An arrowhead grazed my collarbone
Magic wound round my wrist, very inconvenient
Hunger has made my ki unsteady

lines.zh: 雷从上面来，正好打在我肩上
lines.en: Lightning came from above and hit my shoulder

lines.zh: 这里没有可以悬停的地方
lines.en: There is nowhere here to hover
